title: PR #897: feat: Introduce Food Checkout Capability and Fulfillment & Tip Extensions
content: # Description On behalf of the entire **Food Domain Tech Council**, this PR introduces the **Checkout Capability** (`dev.ucp.food.checkout`), **Fulfillment Extension** (`dev.ucp.food.fulfillment`), and **Tip Extension** (`dev.ucp.food.tip`), establishing the foundational data contracts, state lifecycle, and transport bindings for prepared food and beverage orders in UCP. By standardizing single-establishment order scoping, structured dish customization, order-wide delivery/pickup fulfillment (ASAP or scheduled), and courier/staff gratuity across both REST and MCP transports, this capability enables platforms to facilitate food ordering sessions across diverse food businesses (restaurants, cafes, bakeries, food trucks, ghost kitchens, etc.) while leaving menu authority, kitchen state, pricing calculations, and Merchant of Record (MoR) responsibilities with the business. ## Motivation While retail checkout (`dev.ucp.shopping.checkout`) models itemized physical/digital goods with simple quantities and per-item shipments, food commerce introduces distinct transactional dynamics: 1. **Single-Kitchen Freshness Window (`food_establishment`)**: Prepared food is cooked to order and must leave the kitchen within minutes, so a session is bound to exactly one preparation location. Every dish **MUST** come from that establishment's live menu. 2. **Configured Dishes, Not SKUs (`line_item`, `dish`, `modification`)**: A line item pairs a menu `dish` with buyer-selected `modifications[]` (protein, spice level, extra toppings, or `$0` removals/substitutions) and a free-form kitchen `note`. Two units of the same dish with different modifications or notes are distinct line items, and notes **MUST NOT** alter price or structured modifications. 3. **Volatile Kitchen State**: Menus, prices, and prep times seen during discovery are provisional. Dishes get 86'd mid-service, kitchens pause intake under load, and menus switch between dayparts. Every create/update must re-validate against live kitchen state and return authoritative totals and targeted, recoverable errors. 4. **Gratuity as a First-Class Extension (`dev.ucp.food.tip`)**: Courier and counter-staff tips are part of checkout, not an afterthought. Businesses advertise preset options (percentage or absolute); platforms record the buyer's preset or custom choice; the business resolves it into a priced `totals[]` entry. 5. **Delivery vs. Pickup, Now vs. Later (`dev.ucp.food.fulfillment`)**: Fulfillment is order-wide (no split destination deliveries), may be ASAP or scheduled for a specific time, and requires structured multi-select handoff preferences (e.g., contactless drop-off, ring doorbell, curbside pickup) plus courier/pickup instructions. 6. **Food-Safety Disclosures & Live Handoff**: Statutory consumer advisories, allergen, and nutrition notices must be rendered prominently, and on completion buyers need a short callout label (e.g., `#42`), a committed fulfillment window, and a live tracking link rather than a static receipt. ## Scope ### In Scope - **Core Checkout Capability (`dev.ucp.food.checkout`)**: - Full session lifecycle (`incomplete`, `requires_escalation`, `ready_for_complete`, `complete_in_progress`, `completed`, `canceled`) with deterministic handoffs via `continue_url` (e.g., alcohol ID verification, catering review). - Common checkout features including `actions` (step-up work and Accepted Completion), `policies`, `context`, and `signals`. - Food entities: `food_establishment` (`common/types/location_summary.json`, extended with `media`), `line_item`, `dish`, `modification`, `buyer`, and `order_confirmation`. - **Fulfillment Extension (`dev.ucp.food.fulfillment`)**: Order-wide `delivery` / `pickup` methods with type-discriminated destinations (`delivery_address` with `address` and/or `geo`, `business_location`), ASAP vs. scheduled timing via `requested_fulfillment_time`, priced time-window `options[]`, multi-select handoff `preference_options[]` / `selected_preference_option_ids[]`, courier/pickup `notes`, and `available_methods[]` (with `fulfillable_on` and `scheduling`). - **Tip Extension (`dev.ucp.food.tip`)**: Business-suggested `options[]` (`percentage` or `absolute`), Platform-selected `selected_option_id` or `custom_amount`, mutual exclusion (`oneOf`), and resolution into checkout `totals[]` as `type: "tip"`. - **Out-of-Band Cart-to-Checkout Conversion**: `cart_id` support on Create Checkout for mutually recognized out-of-band carts, with strict precedence and rejection rules when unsupported or unrecognized. - **Food-Specific Error, Warning & Disclosure Codes**: - Recoverable kitchen/fulfillment errors: `out_of_stock`, `item_unavailable`, `modification_required`, `modification_invalid`, `note_not_supported`, `location_closed`, `fulfillment_time_unavailable`, `address_undeliverable`, `minimum_order_unmet`. - Warnings: `note_contains_modification`, `preference_option_invalid`, `preference_option_unavailable`, `preference_option_combination_disallowed`. - `disclosure`-tier warnings: `consumer_advisory`, `allergens`, `nutritional_info`, and `totals_changed`. - **Transport Bindings**: Complete REST (OpenAPI 3.1) and MCP (OpenRPC / tool definitions) specifications and examples at `/checkout-sessions*`. - **Payment Extension Interoperability**: Wiring of `payment_ap2_mandate` and `payment_authentication` onto `dev.ucp.food.checkout`. - **Documentation & Tooling Enhancements**: Refactored `main.py` schema macro renderer for filesystem-discovered verticals, relative `$ref` resolution, `$def`/`allOf` type resolution, and path-qualified reference anchors; updated `mkdocs.yml`, `llms.txt` descriptions, `reference.md`, and schema test scaffolds. ### Out of Scope - Upstream menu search/discovery service (dish and modification IDs are assumed to come from upper-funnel discovery) & gradual cart building. - Post-purchase order management (order status webhooks, modifications, cancellations, refunds, substitutions). - Multi-establishment baskets (e.g., food halls / multi-vendor orders) and group ordering. - Catering-specific attributes (headcount, setup, deposits) and table reservations / dine-in ordering. ## Design Details ### 1. Single-Establishment Scope & Shared Menu Identifiers A session is bound to one `food_establishment` (or initialized from a mutually recognized `cart_id`). On requests the Platform sends only opaque, menu-backed identifiers (`food_establishment.id`, `line_items[].dish.id`, `line_items[].modifications[].id`) plus buyer inputs (`quantity`, `note`); all other attributes are Business-authored. ```json { "food_establishment": { "id": "est_luigis_01" }, "line_items": [ { "quantity": 2, "dish": { "id": "dish_margherita_12" }, "modifications": [ { "id": "mod_extra_mozzarella" }, { "id": "mod_fresh_basil" } ], "note": "Well done crust, please" }, { "quantity": 1, "dish": { "id": "dish_caesar" }, "note": "Dressing on the side" } ] } ``` On every create/update, the Business authoritatively re-validates against live operating hours, item and ingredient availability, modifier-group rules, delivery coverage, and order minimums, and expands the response with titles, media, prices, `line_items[].totals`, and `totals[]`. ### 2. Dish Customization: Structured Modifications vs. Kitchen Notes The `line_item` entity separates the menu `dish` from buyer-selected customization: | Mechanism | Field | Priced? | Contract | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | Structured modifications | `line_items[].modifications[]` | Yes (`$0` or more) | Menu-backed IDs; Business validates modifier-group rules (required choices, min/max, mutual exclusion) and echoes `title` / `price`. | | Special instructions | `line_items[].note` | No | Free-form kitchen text. **MUST NOT** alter price or structured modifications. | - `modification.quantity` applies **per unit of the dish** (default `1`); repeated units **MUST** be expressed via `quantity`, not repetition, and Businesses **MUST NOT** infer quantity from duplicate modification IDs. - Line arithmetic: `subtotal = (dish.price + Σ(mod.price × mod.quantity)) × line_items[].quantity`. - When a `note` requests a menu-modeled modifier (at any price, including `$0` removals/substitutions), the Business **SHOULD** return a `note_contains_modification` warning (and **MAY** return `note_not_supported` error when a kitchen request cannot be honored): ```json { "type": "warning", "code": "note_contains_modification", "path": "$.line_items[0].note", "content": "\"Add avocado\" is a paid add-on (+$2.50). Select the Avocado modification to add it; notes are passed to the kitchen as-is and cannot add charges." } ``` ### 3. Food Fulfillment Extension (`dev.ucp.food.fulfillment`) Shares vocabulary with Shopping Fulfillment (`dev.ucp.shopping.fulfillment`) but is deliberately flatter because a food order is cooked, bagged, and handed off together from a single kitchen: | Dimension | Shopping Fulfillment | Food Fulfillment | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | Scope | Per line item (`line_item_ids[]`) | Whole order | | Hierarchy | `methods[]` → `groups[]` → `options[]` | `methods[]` → `options[]` | | Destination | `destinations[]` + `selected_destination_id` | One `destination`, discriminated by `type` | | Timing | Chosen only from Business options | Platform may request a time (`requested_fulfillment_time`) | | Handoff | — | `preference_options[]` + `selected_preference_option_ids[]` + `notes` | - **Destinations**: `delivery_address` (Platform-authored `address` and/or `geo`, at least one required) or `business_location` (Business-authored `location_summary`, response-only). - **Timing & Availability**: Omitting `requested_fulfillment_time` means **ASAP**; an RFC 3339 timestamp means **scheduled**. `available_methods[]` advertises supported methods (`delivery`, `pickup`), earliest `fulfillable_on` (RFC 3339 timestamp), and `scheduling` (`asap_only`, `scheduled_only`, `asap_and_scheduled`). If a requested time is unavailable, the Business returns a `recoverable` `fulfillment_time_unavailable` (or `location_closed`) error and **SHOULD** offer nearest alternative `options[]`. - **Multi-Select Handoff Preferences**: `preference_options[]` and `selected_preference_option_ids[]` live on the fulfillment method (`methods[]`) for both delivery and pickup. In responses, `selected_preference_option_ids[]` contains only the selections the Business will honor; unhonored or conflicting options are dropped without blocking `ready_for_complete` and reported via `preference_option_*` warnings. ```json { "id": "method_delivery", "type": "delivery", "destination": { "id": "dest_home", "type": "delivery_address", "address": { "street_address": "450 Serra Mall", "extended_address": "Apt 3B", "address_locality": "Stanford", "address_region": "CA", "postal_code": "94305", "address_country": "US" } }, "preference_options": [ { "id": "pref_leave_at_door", "label": "Leave at my door" }, { "id": "pref_hand_to_me", "label": "Hand it to me" }, { "id": "pref_meet_outside", "label": "Meet outside" }, { "id": "pref_ring_bell", "label": "Ring the doorbell" } ], "selected_preference_option_ids": ["pref_leave_at_door", "pref_ring_bell"], "notes": "Gate code #4210, second floor", "selected_option_id": "opt_standard", "options": [ { "id": "opt_priority", "title": "Priority Delivery", "description": "Sent directly to you with no other stops", "earliest_fulfillment_time": "2026-04-10T18:25:00-07:00", "latest_fulfillment_time": "2026-04-10T18:35:00-07:00", "totals": [{ "type": "total", "amount": 599 }] }, { "id": "opt_standard", "title": "Standard Delivery", "earliest_fulfillment_time": "2026-04-10T18:35:00-07:00", "latest_fulfillment_time": "2026-04-10T18:50:00-07:00", "totals": [{ "type": "total", "amount": 299 }] } ] } ``` ### 4. Food Tip Extension (`dev.ucp.food.tip`) The `dev.ucp.food.tip` extension adds a top-level `tip` object separating what the Business suggests from what the buyer chooses, while `totals[]` holds the resolved money: - **Suggestions (`tip.options[]`, Business-authored)**: `id`, `unit` (`percentage` | `absolute`), and `amount` (percent or ISO 4217 minor units). No labels — Platforms render `"18%"`, `"$5"`. - **Choice (Platform-authored)**: `oneOf` admits Preset (`selected_option_id` on update), Custom (`custom_amount` on create or update; `0` = no tip), or Unset (neither set; adds nothing to `totals[]` until an explicit selection is submitted). - **Resolution**: Percentage options are computed against the pre-discount `subtotal` entry in `totals[]`. Any non-zero selected tip **MUST** appear as a `type: "tip"` entry in `totals[]` with `display_text` **REQUIRED**. If a fulfillment switch replaces `tip.options[]` and invalidates a prior `selected_option_id`, the Business clears `selected_option_id` back to Unset and surfaces a `notice` warning. ```json { "tip": { "options": [ { "id": "tip_15", "unit": "percentage", "amount": 15 }, { "id": "tip_18", "unit": "percentage", "amount": 18 }, { "id": "tip_20", "unit": "percentage", "amount": 20 }, { "id": "tip_5usd", "unit": "absolute", "amount": 500 } ], "selected_option_id": "tip_18" }, "totals": [ { "type": "subtotal", "display_text": "Subtotal", "amount": 5000 }, { "type": "fulfillment", "display_text": "Standard Delivery", "amount": 299 }, { "type": "fee", "display_text": "Service & Regulatory Fees", "amount": 550, "lines": [ { "display_text": "Service Fee", "amount": 350 }, { "display_text": "City Courier Regulatory Fee", "amount": 200 } ] }, { "type": "tax", "display_text": "Tax (8.75%)", "amount": 438 }, { "type": "tip", "display_text": "Courier Tip (18%)", "amount": 900 }, { "type": "total", "display_text": "Total", "amount": 7187 } ] } ``` ### 5. Error Handling, Disclosures & Order Confirmation - **Recoverable kitchen-state errors**: In addition to shared standard errors, food Businesses **SHOULD** use food-specific codes (`out_of_stock`, `item_unavailable`, `modification_required`, `modification_invalid`, `note_not_supported`, `location_closed`, `fulfillment_time_unavailable`, `address_undeliverable`, `minimum_order_unmet`) with precise JSONPath `path` targeting so Platforms can offer targeted recovery. - **Disclosures**: `consumer_advisory`, `allergens`, `nutritional_info`, and `totals_changed` use `presentation: "disclosure"` and **MUST** be shown prominently near the referenced item and never auto-dismissed. Operational context (e.g., `high_demand`) uses `notice`. - **Order confirmation**: On `completed`, `order` carries `id` (required), `tracking_url` (required, live preparation/courier status), an optional short `label` used at the counter, shelf, or locker, and an optional committed fulfillment window (`earliest_fulfillment_time` / `latest_fulfillment_time`). ```json { "order": { "id": "ord_food_9876543210", "label": "#42", "tracking_url": "https://food.example.com/orders/ord_food_9876543210", "earliest_fulfillment_time": "2026-04-10T18:35:00-07:00", "latest_fulfillment_time": "2026-04-10T18:50:00-07:00" } } ``` ### 6. Documentation Engine Enhancement (`main.py`) Adding the `food` vertical exposed several assumptions in the schema macro renderer, which previously defaulted to `shopping` and resolved `$ref`s by bare filename. Because food and shopping share file names (e.g., `food/fulfillment.json` vs. `shopping/fulfillment.json`, `food/types/line_item.json` vs. `shopping/types/line_item.json`), this produced incorrect cross-links and table contents. `main.py` was refactored to: - Discover verticals from the filesystem (every `source/schemas/` sub-directory except `common/` and `transports/`), with no vertical treated specially. - Resolve `$ref`s relative to the containing file first (standard JSON Schema semantics), falling back to name-based lookup across protocol, common, the active vertical, and — only if unambiguous — other verticals. - Emit path-qualified reference anchors (e.g., `#food-types-fulfillment`) from `auto_generate_schema_reference`, so schemas sharing a title across verticals remain individually addressable, and point every type link to the page that actually renders that schema. `reference.md` now passes an explicit `base_dir` for shopping and adds food sections alongside common, shopping, and lodging. ## Category (Required) - [x] **Core Protocol**: Changes to the base communication layer, global context, or breaking refactors. (Requires Technical Council approval) - [ ] **Governance/Contributing**: Updates to GOVERNANCE.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, or CODEOWNERS. (Requires Governance Council approval) - [x] **Capability**: New schemas (Discovery, Cart, etc.) or extensions. (Requires DevOps Maintainer approval) ## Related Issues #518 ## Checklist - [x] I have followed the [Contributing Guide](https://github.com/Universal-Commerce-Protocol/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) (including Conventional Commits title requirements and `!` for breaking changes). - [x] I have updated the documentation (if applicable). - [x] My changes pass all local linting and formatting checks. - [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works. - [x] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes. - [x] (For Core/Capability) I have included/updated the relevant JSON schemas. - [ ] I have regenerated Python Pydantic models by running generate_models.sh under python_sdk. ## Screenshots / Logs (if applicable)
